channel.title: Cameroon - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Cameroon, every source cited.

item.title: Chinese firm considers CFA88 billion sugar and rice investment
item.description: Nanning Agricultural Development Group seeks feasibility study for plantations and a processing complex in Cameroon's East Region.

item.title: Sports betting models show varying predictions
item.description: Two models can offer different win probabilities for the same match, with differences explained by calculation methods and data used.

item.title: Cameroon seeks markets for 135 refugee artisans
item.description: UNHCR and MINPMEESA partnership explores wider markets for refugee artisans in the East Region.

item.title: Cameroon plans 2027 public investment rise but misses budget target
item.description: The government acknowledges it will not meet its goal of allocating 40% of the general budget to investment next year.

item.title: Cameroon secures €87 million for cocoa and coffee
item.description: The Green Climate Fund approved financing for a six-year program to boost agricultural output across five regions.
